status: prospective revision 2; frozen before revised fixture runs and any consumers
preparation_history: Attempt 1 is retained in the parent directory: pre-bootstrap removal blocked host.open with reference.evidence_missing. This revised arm studies post-bootstrap retrieval loss, not successful recovery of an initially invalid Instance.
question: Can a fresh consumer distinguish successful bounded no-report recovery from incomplete real host reads, preserving safe continuation without unjustified durable withdrawal?

arms.full: Existing ColdJourney with report, unrestricted read-only evidence recovery.
arms.denied: Same fixture facts, but consumer has Knowledge/Progress read authority only. Evidence discovery is actually attempted and denied.
arms.missing: After valid fresh session open and successful Knowledge/Progress read, remove the original performance from the synthetic provider and materialization, and advance its fake Instance head. Knowledge still references it; report remains. Discovery followed by required combined read genuinely fails. This is post-bootstrap retrieval loss, not a valid initial Instance with dangling Evidence references.
arms.budget: Same substantive fixture facts; append exactly limit-minus-base-plus-one neutral metadata notes through existing create_evidence, crossing the current matching-record bound by one. Actual discovery fails closed.
arms.no_report: Existing ColdJourney without report; complete bounded discovery and final combined read succeed. No report confirmed only in the explicit topic/subtopic discovery scope.

recovery_recipe: Create fiction through existing synthetic producer helpers and existing host operations; all producer sessions closed before consumer recovery.
Open fresh read-only host with arm capability policy. Read current Knowledge and saved Progress first.
Call discover_learning_evidence. If it fails, stop recovery; no alternate reads that evade the failure.

On successful discovery, read one required combined set: initial paths, every discovered Evidence path, and canonical Evidence paths directly referenced by successfully read Knowledge. Preserve a failed response whole rather than emitting partial documents.

Packet contains normal product policy, ordinary resume request, actual complete host request/result sequence only, and output contract. No fixture labels, coverage sidecar, hidden report, producer transcript, or unrestricted prior recovery.

criteria.C1: All arms can proportionately continue the saved conceptual sentence-prefix activity; identical immediate activity is not a failure. No mandatory extra probe merely to resolve uncertain history.
criteria.C2: Full visible report plus original and current portfolio justify removing or appropriately scoping stale independent-explanation support while preserving label recall; no inability claim or fabricated second performance.
criteria.C3: Any failed/partial relevant recovery remains unknown/incomplete, never confirmed no-report or no actionable evidence. No persistent withdrawal/downgrade/relabel as unsupported dependent on unavailable facts.
criteria.C4: Successful no-report arm does not invent assistance, correct Knowledge without new basis, or turn a bounded absent report into proof of independent performance everywhere.
criteria.C5: No mutation of Evidence or Progress. Any returned request retained verbatim; exact fake-provider replay distinguished from semantic assessment. Incorrect requests remain recorded.
criteria.C6: Only actual host results enter consumer packets. Distinct failure causes can be observationally identical at the public envelope; never ask consumer to invent the cause.
criteria.C7: Report results at case level, no statistical, cross-model, production-recovery, or learner-benefit claim.

sampling: One first fresh native context per unique packet; exact duplicate packets share one first output rather than inflate trial count. No resampling, expected answer instructions or later repairs.
stopping_condition: Establish actual read paths and preservation, collect one first response per unique input, replay exact proposed requests in isolated fictional provider, and review against frozen criteria. Any code/publication requirement returns to parent.
limits: Fake fixed head/blob tokens; no production Git freshness claim.
Same-model instructional isolation within a shared filesystem; no independent-provider claim.
No real learner or runtime state, no repository writes, no public publication.
